local_CPU_contract.nonzero_store: On the nonzero fallthrough, C07A8D 83 /4 sign-extends imm8 00 and performs a dword read-modify-write at current SS:(EBP-4) using 32-bit effective-address arithmetic. This reads the prior dword even though the successful result is zero; it may fault. EAX/EBP/ESP are unchanged by the instruction. Successful AND sets CF=OF=SF=0, ZF=PF=1; AF is undefined.
